To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

the energy consumption per bit of communication is a function of the source and sink power-efficiency factors, and that the power-efficiency factor is the key to understanding and comparing the energy consumption per unit of information of cascaded systems.

the power efficiency factor is a critical parameter for evaluating the energy efficiency of cascaded communication systems and that the consumption factor is a critical tool for evaluating the energy consumption of cascaded communication circuits.
the power-efficiency factor of a cascaded system is the ratio of the total power consumed by the system to the total power consumed if the system was not cascaded.
